exposure: fetal fraction of cell-free DNA (cfDNA) in maternal plasma at 10+0 to 13+6 weeks' gestation
cohort: The study included 3169 pregnancies, consisting of 3066 term deliveries and 103 spontaneous preterm deliveries.
finding: Measurement of fetal fraction in maternal plasma at 11-13 weeks' gestation was not significantly predictive of spontaneous preterm delivery.
gest_age: Exposure measurement taken at 10+0 to 13+6 weeks' gestation
